  ∑' n : ℕ, (((⌊(2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * x⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) / (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1))

lemma summable_cantor (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : Summable fun n : ℕ => (((⌊(2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * x⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) / (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) := by
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := hx.1
  have hx1 : x ≤ 1 := hx.2
  have h_nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ (((⌊(2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * x⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) / (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) := by
    intro n
    positivity
  have h_bound : ∀ n, (((⌊(2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * x⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) / (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) ^ (n + 1) := by
    intro n
    have hfloor : ((⌊(2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * x⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * x := by
      exact mod_cast Int.floor_le ((2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * x)
    calc

        refine (div_le_div_right (by positivity)).mpr hfloor
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) / (3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) := by
        refine (div_le_div_right (by positivity)).mpr ?_
        nlinarith
      _ = ((2 : ℝ) / 3) ^ (n + 1) := by ring
  have hsum : Summable fun n : ℕ => ((2 : ℝ) / 3) ^ (n + 1) := by
    have hsum' : Summable fun n : ℕ => ((2 : ℝ) / 3) ^ n :=
